primary_evaluation: Actual R01-R04 testing, fold0 only, strict-v1; previously inspected development benchmark, not independent confirmation
normal_evaluation: Existing source-disjoint 5-fold OOF; never pool evaluation scores into calibration
synthetic: Auxiliary diagnosis only; existing eligible e9_cases_v2 plus freeze at source onsets 1,8,24,48 with length halfup(.1T); no candidate selection
feature_cache: Frozen RTX PRO 6000 CUDA features runs/stride1_seed42; no encoder retraining

stall.cdf: FIT video-equal weighted right-continuous lower CDF, (n*F+1)/(n+1), mixed with global; invalid lags contribute zero evidence
stall.context: S3 causal posterior theta locked at detected low-motion run entry; S2 current same posterior; theta in cycles [0,1)
stall.reference: k = video-equal mean + population sd of valid min-lag evidence on REF, including non-low-motion observations
stall.accumulation: U=max(0,U+(stride/2)*(s-k)) only while low-motion and both lags valid; reset on motion return; S0 elapsed low-motion source frames/T
stall.calibration: Existing TailCalibrator on fresh valid REF cumulative scores, no THR normalization; invalid evidence yields calibrated stall 0
stall.fusion: max(C or CP, calibrated stall); w=1 fixed; no separate OR alarm

adaptive.L: median lowest ceil(.2*n) fresh scores in first48 source frames; enabled at source frame48, not retroactive
adaptive.Lref: median of per-REF-video L; videos shorter than48 excluded; short evaluation videos retain Tf

threshold: Existing video-equal D-window maxima and strict >; nominal q99 does not guarantee actual 1% FPR
event_deadline: min(actual positive interval length, halfup(.2T)); auxiliary freeze clipped to freeze duration; legacy D metric separate

bootstrap.uncertainty: fixed checkpoints; file independence unverified; seeds are not independent data

engineering_targets.joint_actual_events: more than CP; separately report events lost relative to C

selection: No model choice using actual test labels or auxiliary edits; publish every fixed arm including negative outcomes
